name: empty-state
purpose: The fleet's quiet nothing-here message: a real Nimiq duotone icon at the muted ink, a full-ink primary line, an optional muted secondary line and at most one understated action, in block (page level) and row (one quiet line inside a list card) sizes with on-light and on-dark ink ladders. Replaces the one-line empty states 13 apps hand-roll.

props.name: title
props.description: The primary line: full ink (#1F2348 on light, #FFF on dark), 18px 700. Keep it one short fragment, no period, no dashes. Skip it for the row size.

props.name: message
props.description: The secondary line at the muted ink (navy 50% on light, white 60% on dark); in the row size it is the single quiet line. The default slot overrides it. Keep it one short fragment, no period, no dashes.

props.name: size
props.description: block is the page-level size (48px padding, 80px spot-illustration icon, 18px title, 15px message); row is the one-line list-level state inside a card (26px padding, 20px glyph beside a 14px line). HTML variant: add class 'row'.

props.name: dark
props.description: White ink channel for navy surfaces; the action switches to the .nq-button-s inverse recipe. HTML variant: add class 'on-dark'. The navy surface itself must be the bottom-right radial, never a flat fill (rule 7).

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Renders the ONE understated action button (emits 'action' on click). One primary action max per PRINCIPLES; navy capsule, never green (rule 5). HTML variant: the .es-action button, delete it if unused.

props.name: slot: icon
props.description: A real Nimiq duotone icon (assets/icons/duotone/*.svg) riding currentColor at the muted ink; the CSS sizes it to 80px in the block (the skill's spot-illustration tier) and 20px in the row. An emoji still works (chorecoin legacy, 44px line) but is no longer the default; never a generic icon set. HTML variant: the .es-icon div, delete it if unused; keep aria-hidden (decorative).

props.name: slot: action
props.description: Replaces the built-in action entirely (e.g. an <a>); still one action max. Give the element class 'es-action' to inherit the capsule styling (the component ships :slotted selectors).

notes:
ORIGINAL composition (flag-hex precedent), so verified:false; reference.png is snapped from truth/truth.html and nq verify guards the demo against it as a regression check. There is no upstream empty-state component (the wallet's empty screen is a whole layout, not a reusable block), so this formalizes the fleet's de facto standard: chorecoin public/app.css .empty (padding 26px 18px, centered, muted, 14px 600, big emoji in the line), tipjar .tips-empty (28px 16px, 15px, 'plain body text on the white feed card, set by whitespace'), drip .empty (15px, dim, 3x space padding), nimpot and snappos .empty-note (14px, ink-50). V2 2026-07-10 after Andjroo's design review ('The block, that's ugly. The row inside a list has nothing. On navy, all caught up, that is terrible'): the raw-emoji default, the bare one-line row and the 'All caught up' sample copy are gone. Design decisions: (a) radical simplicity per PRINCIPLES law 4 still: whitespace + type hierarchy do the structural work; no borders, no boxes, no invented ornament; the component is transparent and the page or card supplies the surface. (b) Icon treatment: a real Nimiq duotone icon (assets/icons/duotone/*.svg) riding currentColor at the muted ink; the set's secondary shapes carry their own opacity .4 within the SAME color (skill icon rule: same color at .4, never a second hue). Sized by role per the skill: 80px in the block (the 80-130px spot/result illustration tier) and 20px beside the row line (the 16-24px glyph tier). Emoji stays possible via the slot (chorecoin legacy, 44px) but is no longer the demo or default; never a generic icon set. Demo icons chosen gradient-free (some duotone icons embed currentColor radialGradients whose duplicate ids could trip rule 3 when inlined twice): nim-phone (receive NIM on your wallet), cash-register (tips received), magnifying-glass (search/filter). (c) Type ladder calibrated against the wallet's real empty screen (screenshots/nimiq-wallet/wallet.nimiq.com-desktop.png: full-ink bold title over a muted secondary line, generous whitespace): .es-title 18px 700 full ink (#1F2348 / #FFF on dark), .es-message 15px 600 muted (navy 50% / white 60%; contrast ratios as before: navy .5 on white 3.11:1, deliberately matching the brand's own sub-AA secondary text which nq lint warns rather than gates; white .6 on flat navy 6.33:1, 6.93:1 on the gradient corner; action full-contrast navy on 7% tint 12.45:1, white on 20% inverse chip 7.95:1). Rhythm: 6px title-to-message via container gap, icon margin-bottom 14px (= 20px to title), action margin-top 18px (= 24px from message). (d) Row size is intentional, not bare: flex-row, 20px duotone glyph at the muted ink beside a single quiet 14px line, 10px gap, centered; still one line only, no title, no action. (e) The action is unchanged: the legacy .nq-button-s capsule converted from the 8px root to px (27px, padding 0 12px, 14px 700, neutral bg rgba(31,35,72,.07), hover .12 with darkened navy #151833, inverse white .2/.25 on dark), radius 999px on the skill's pill tier; focus-visible ring 2px #0582CA offset 3px; transitions ride --nimiq-ease with cubic-bezier(0.25, 0, 0, 1) fallback plus a prefers-reduced-motion guard. One primary action max (PRINCIPLES); navy, never green (rule 5). (f) Title and message are

, not headings, so empty states never pollute the page outline; copy stays short fragments with no periods (rule 16 discipline) and no dashes (rule 18); the 'All caught up' sample was dropped per Andjroo, demo copy is realistic fleet copy (No transactions yet / Receive your first NIM to get started + Receive NIM, No tips yet, No results for this filter + Clear filters). (g) Two sizes only: block for a page section and row for an empty list inside a card, the two scales the fleet actually ships. Demo (= truth) shows block on the #F8F8F8 page with the 80px nim-phone + title + secondary + action, row inside a white card (radius 10px, the app-card shadow 0 4px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.111)) with the cash-register glyph, and the on-dark block (magnifying-glass, white ink ladder, inverse action) on the navy radial (rule 7). Pairs with transaction-list and the card components; use status-alert for errors that need attention rather than an empty state. nq lint on demo.html: 0 errors; the two advisory warnings stay: the 27px tap target is the shipped legacy .nq-button-s height (3.375rem at the 8px root, same as v1), and the off-scale spacing values are the fleet's own row padding (26px, chorecoin) plus the v2 rhythm (10/14/18px, tuned to the wallet reference rather than snapped to the marketing scale).
